While checksums are provided and not set to 'SKIP', their presence or absence is irrelevant for this safety gate, as no download or verification occurs during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of executing malicious code.
